info.name: VoiceGenie Public REST Calls Campaigns API
Add a call to a recurring campaign

items.docs: Queue a new call for a customer number inside an existing recurring campaign. The token, workspaceId, campaignId and customerNumber must be present strings; customerNumber must be in E.164 format (leading country code with a plus sign, no spaces, hyphens or brackets).
Pause or resume a running campaign by specifying the campaignId and desired action.

info.name: Remove a customer from a campaign

items.docs: Remove a specific customer number from an ongoing campaign to stop further outreach. customerNumber must be E.164 formatted.
